section_3_system_graph.declared_order: Local VEC Assembler -> Deterministic Gate 0 -> Fresh Independent DP -> ProjectionAST

sections_10_and_13_required_dependencies.gate_requirement: Gate 0 must include Projection identity, and a Gate 0 failure must not call DP.

current_a8_composition.reason: This is the only order in which the existing single canonical ProjectionAST can be supplied to Gate 0 for its required Projection-identity check before DP is called.

root_cause: The frozen authority simultaneously draws ProjectionAST after DP and requires a single ProjectionAST to be available to Gate 0 before DP. The A8 task registry explicitly cites §3, §6, §11, and §15 A8, so a construction implementation cannot treat the §3 edge as an inactive historical diagram.

rejected_implementations.option: Move Projection after DP to follow the §3 graph literally.
rejected_implementations.rejection: Gate 0 would have no ProjectionAST whose identity it can validate before DP, violating §13.

rejected_implementations.option: Create Projection before Gate 0 and retain the current A8 order.
rejected_implementations.rejection: This selects the §§10/13 interpretation over the explicitly cited §3 graph without a frozen authority clarification.

rejected_implementations.option: Create a provisional ProjectionAST for Gate 0 and another one after DP.
rejected_implementations.rejection: This creates two projection authorities and violates the single-ProjectionAST rule in §10.

rejected_implementations.option: Remove Projection identity from Gate 0 so Projection can stay after DP.
rejected_implementations.rejection: That changes the A7-owned Gate 0 contract and contradicts §13; it is outside A8 ownership.

failure_action.action: Fail-close A8 and retain its next-task position in ReleaseLedger.
failure_action.reason: No allowed A8-only change can prove compliance with every cited frozen requirement. No old plan, test fixture, or current implementation order may resolve the conflict by implication.

required_recovery: Freeze a successor architecture authority that explicitly defines the single ProjectionAST lifecycle and the required ordering of Projection, Gate 0, and fresh DP.
Rebase ReleaseLedger against that successor authority before re-claiming A8; do not reuse this A8 failure as completion evidence.
Only after the rebase returns A8 as the unique task may the text-shadow composition be repaired and re-verified.
